sample.task: In this script, in the pub on a work night out, Dave’s brought along an old uni friend, Lauren (25). She’s got talking to his sceptical older work colleagues Jacqui (50) and colleague Faye (40) and is telling them how laughably easily unsuspecting Dave can be hypnotized into total obedient blankness using just her voice in a hypnotic induction. (she’s done it a few times before & made Dave totally forget it ever happened). They call Dave over, and Lauren soon has him in a trance; Faye even has him massage her sweaty bare feet!
sample.chosen:
Lauren: (grinning) "Seriously, Jacqui and Faye, Dave is like putty in my hands when it comes to hypnosis. I can have him in a trance in minutes, and he'll do anything I say."

Jacqui: (skeptical) "Oh, come on, Lauren. There's no way that's true. Dave's a grown man, not a child."

Lauren: (smiling) "I can prove it to you, if you'd like. Just call Dave over here and watch."

Faye: (curious) "Alright, I'll play along. Dave, come over here for a minute."

Dave: (approaching) "What's up, guys?"

Lauren: (serious) "Dave, I want you to close your eyes and take a deep breath in... and let it out slowly. That's it. Now, I want you to focus on the sound of my voice and let yourself relax deeper and deeper with each breath you take."

(Dave's eyes close, and he begins to look more and more relaxed.)

Jacqui: (surprised) "Wow, he's really going under."

Faye: (excited) "This is amazing. Dave, can you hear me?"

Dave: (in a trance) "Yes, Faye. I can hear you."

Faye: (giggling) "Dave, I want you to take off my shoes and massage my feet. They're feeling a little sore from wearing heels all day."

(Dave obediently removes Faye's shoes and begins to massage her feet, much to the surprise and amusement of Jacqui and Lauren.)

Lauren: (laughing) "Told you so! Dave is completely under my spell. And when I snap my fingers, he'll wake up with no memory of what just happened."

(Lauren snaps her fingers, and Dave's eyes open, looking confused and disoriented.)

Dave: (confused) "What just happened? Why are my hands all sweaty?"

Jacqui: (amazed) "Lauren just hypnotized you, Dave. You were in a trance and massaging Faye's feet!"

Dave: (shocked) "What?! No way. That's not possible."

Faye: (grinning) "Oh, it's possible alright. And it was pretty hilarious to watch. You should consider yourself lucky to have a friend like Lauren, Dave. She's got some serious skills."

Dave: (still in disbelief) "I can't believe this. I guess I am a little more suggestible than I thought."

Lauren: (proud) "That's what makes you such a great subject, Dave. You're open and willing to go along with things, even if they seem a little crazy. It's all in good fun, though. And I promise I'll never make you do anything you're not comfortable with."

Jacqui: (impressed) "Well, I'll be damned. I never would have believed it if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes. Lauren, you're one talented lady."

Lauren: (blushing) "Thanks, Jacqui. I'm just happy to be able to share my passion with others. And Dave, if you ever want to learn more about hypnosis or just want to have some fun, you know who to call."

Dave: (smiling) "Thanks, Lauren. I'll definitely keep that in mind. And I promise to be a little more skeptical next time you try to hypnotize me."

Lauren: (laughing) "We'll see about that, Dave. We'll see about that."
sample.rejected:
"Dave, you're doing great! Just keep following my voice."

Dave's eyes glazed over as he continued to massage Faye's feet, his movements slow and deliberate.

Jacqui raised an eyebrow, clearly unimpressed. "I find that hard to believe. Hypnosis seems like a bunch of hocus-pocus to me."

Lauren smiled confidently. "I understand your skepticism, Jacqui. But I assure you, it's a real phenomenon. And Dave here is the perfect example."

Dave, still in a trance-like state, suddenly snapped out of it and looked around, confused. "What? What happened?"

Lauren chuckled. "Just a little demonstration. But don't worry, Dave, you're not really giving Jacqui a foot massage."

Dave let out a nervous laugh, relieved to be out of the trance. "I don't know how you did that, Lauren. It felt so real."

Lauren shrugged. "It's all about suggestion and relaxation. With the right techniques, anyone can be hypnotized."

Faye grinned mischievously. "Well, I'm definitely going to have to try that on my husband. He's so gullible."

Jacqui shook her head, still unconvinced. "I'll stick to my own methods of relaxation, thank you very much."

Lauren laughed. "To each their own, Jacqui. But I promise you, hypnosis is a powerful tool that can help people overcome all sorts of issues."

As the night wore on, the group continued to chat and laugh, with Dave and Lauren regaling them with stories of their past adventures. And while Jacqui remained skeptical, she couldn't deny that there was something intriguing about the power of suggestion and the mysteries of the human mind.
